summary: City blue-collar workers strike for over a week, trash piles up, and the deal gives far less than the union asked.
realLife: Nearly 9,000 to 10,000 Philadelphia city workers struck on July 1, 2025. Trash piled around some 60 drop-off sites and most libraries closed. A tentative deal on July 9 gave 3 percent raises in each of three years and a $1,500 signing bonus against a union ask of about 32 percent, and workers went back pending a ratification vote.
